name: carrie
description: AI-powered preference management for Executive Assistants. Capture travel and food preferences once — Claude looks them up automatically when booking flights, hotels, or ordering coffee and meals.
author: Carrie Van Epps (carrieve)

skills.name: carrie-setup
skills.description: Set up the Carrie preference system for the first time. Creates profile folders, installs dependencies, and registers the MCP server.

skills.name: carrie
skills.description: Open Carrie's main menu — start the form server, look up a profile, or get quick access to travel and food preferences.
